name: Kagaku to Mahou no Kasou Sekai Vol. 2
original_name: 科学と魔法の仮想世界Vol.2
source:
Protagonist Akira Kido and his platonic friend Sanae were into a VR game called Fantasia.
Akira met a young girl named Meru in the game, who appeared to be fleeing. He traced her to the
gates of a city where Sanae was waiting.

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/eng/work/=/product_id/RE132463.html]DLsite English[/url]]
